manual_steps: Choose window bounds and mission scope.
Approve each discovery window before any bridge.
Approve each bridge block before writes.
Interpret pass/fail audits and decide accept or reject.
Trigger rollback by manifest scope when a gate fails.
Update roadmap and next approved mission.
automated_steps: mine_clean_course_zones.py scans raceform and writes candidate, rejection, and cursor artifacts.
bridge_oasis_block.py selects validated candidates, writes races/race_results/runner_results, persists a manifest, then invokes manifest-scoped HFS reconstruction.
backfill_historical_feature_store.py rebuilds HFS rows from manifest or race batches and runs integrity RPC heartbeats.
normalize_historical_provenance.py dry-runs and applies metadata-only provenance remediation.
Audit scripts replay manifest scopes or macro logic without bridging new rows.
approval_gates: Bridge audit approval after race_results/runner_results writes.
HFS audit approval after manifest-scoped reconstruction.
Global audit approval before any training discussion.
Checkpoint/savepoint approval before major control-plane or macro work.
failure_stops: Runner parity or winner parity failure.
Missing vectors or vector length drift.
Rollback incompleteness after a rejected block.
rollback_paths: Current rollback path is operational and manifest-scoped, but not packaged as a dedicated script.
Recovery protocol requires checking manifest scope across races, race_results, runner_results, and historical_feature_store until residual rows are zero.
Rejected Block 025 proves the rollback pattern works when manually executed against manifest scope.
known_weak_spots: No dedicated scripted global clean spine audit entrypoint exists; current audit is artifact-driven and agent-operated.
bridge_oasis_block.py has no dry-run mode and is not transactionally coupled to rollback.
Discovery codifies accounting and duplicate clean event checks, but not non_target_count or candidate_collision_count as first-class outputs.
Final-window sizing still depends on operator-supplied max-races.
The working tree currently contains unrelated unstaged changes outside the checkpoint.

B_tool_registry.purpose: Discovery-only clean race index mining for approved oasis courses using event-key validation.
known_risks: Writes local artifacts even though it is read-only to the database.
Cursor is updated at end of run, so interrupted runs can leave partial local state.
non_target_count and candidate_collision_count are not codified as emitted metrics.

B_tool_registry.purpose: Controlled bridge of approved clean candidates plus manifest-scoped HFS invocation and block audit.
required_preconditions: previous manifests and excluded IDs known
known_risks: No built-in rollback mode.
No dry-run selection mode for preflight without writes.
HFS runs in a separate subprocess, so bridge and reconstruction are not one atomic transaction.
Final-window block size must be adjusted explicitly or the script hard-fails when it cannot fill max-races.

B_tool_registry.purpose: Manifest-scoped or batch-scoped HFS reconstruction for historical and live rows.
known_risks: No native rollback.
Depends on live scoring code paths outside the OASIS script set.
Macro year is clamped to 2012-2024 today, which blocks honest 2025 scoring.
Integrity RPC heartbeats are not a substitute for the full post-run block audit.

B_tool_registry.purpose: Metadata-only remediation for accepted historical OASIS races and HFS rows.
required_preconditions: macro_year_used must match race year in HFS scope
known_risks: No native rollback snapshot beyond git/artifact savepoints.
Applies broad scoped upserts rather than manifest-scoped block deltas.
Must not be used against rows with macro-year mismatch.

B_tool_registry.purpose: Manifest-scoped forensic signal-path trace for historical HFS reconstruction.
required_preconditions: Referenced race IDs are already present
known_risks: No structured JSON output.
Audit is manifest-scoped but mainly console-driven.
Useful for forensic tracing, not for canonical acceptance evidence by itself.

B_tool_registry.purpose: Manifest-scoped dry-run audit of macro year selection versus race date.
required_preconditions: Referenced rows are bridged or replayable
known_risks: No structured artifact output.
Uses monkey-patching for macro trace capture.
Relies on the scoring path to remain import-compatible.

B_tool_registry.purpose: Populate racing_horses from raceform with deterministic IDs and a keyset cursor.
required_preconditions: Operator understands this mutates the global horse registry
known_risks: Writes production identity registry directly.
Cursor can advance on partial apply operations.
No provenance or manifest scoping for OASIS windows.

B_tool_registry.purpose: Legacy archive discovery/bridge hybrid from pre-OASIS phases.
inputs: implicit args used in code: limit_races, offset, max_scan, dry_run
required_preconditions: Do not use for current OASIS doctrine
known_risks: Uses bare race_id logic rather than the event identity contract.
No manifests, provenance tags, or HFS coupling.
Current repo snapshot appears incomplete: no CLI footer is present.

B_tool_registry.purpose: Read-only RPC wrapper for lightweight HFS integrity heartbeats.
known_risks: Covers only duplicate_count, missing_winner_count, missing_vector_count, and checked_race_count.
Not a full substitute for block or global audit.

B_tool_registry.purpose: Legacy read-only density scan of archive quality by course and year-month.
known_risks: Legacy tool; not event-key contract aware.
No frozen artifacts or cursors.
Useful for exploration, not for canonical OASIS workflow.

B_tool_registry.purpose: Whole-spine acceptance audit for historical OASIS rows.
known_risks: No dedicated script exists in the repo.
Repeatability depends on agent procedure plus saved artifacts.
Should become a canonical scripted audit before training.

data/velo_artifact_index.json if new artifacts are created without refresh.

Chat memory and copied counts outside saved artifacts.
Cursor files after interrupted discovery runs.

Any accepted bridge via manifest and DB count verification.
Global audit review from saved JSON/MD artifacts.
Checkpoint branch restore using branch plus canonical state file.
what_needs_stronger_state_handling: Auto-generated state transitions after each accepted/rejected run.

Scripted recording of next approved mission.
Explicit dirty-worktree marker in canonical state.

stale_state_risks: Manifest can exist for a rejected block even after rollback

duplicate_state_risks: The same counts and block outcomes are stored in state JSON, docs, chat, and audit reports.

data/velo_current_state.json is canonical for phase and roadmap.

Git checkpoint commit is canonical for code/documentation state.

The global audit process is currently repeatable only through artifacts and operator procedure, not a single script.
2025 rows remain blocked until macro support is extended honestly.

Confirm latest failed block is fully rolled back.
Confirm accepted DB counts match canonical state.
Confirm next mission is approved in the canonical state.
